# Arctic Peoples

> A resource hub for the Indigenous Peoples' Secretariat and Arctic Council member organizations and staff.

Arctic Peoples provides information about indigenous representation and coordination within the Arctic Council framework. The site features staff directories and contact information for the Indigenous Peoples' Secretariat, which serves as a key organizational body for Arctic indigenous communities.

## Key Topics

- Indigenous Peoples' Secretariat
- Arctic Council
- Staff Directory
- Contact Information
- Team Members
- Organization Staff
- Rosa-Máren Magga
- Linda Lyberth Kristiansen
- Miyuki Qiajunnguaq Daorana
- Anna Degteva
- Alayna Ningeongan
- Arctic Indigenous Leadership
- IPS Team
